channel.title: Net Sense
channel.description: Studio network monitoring for Mac, by Nathaniel Labs.

item.description:
# Net Sense 1.2.0
Live telemetry release.
- Replaces the disruptive on-demand speed tests with always-on live per-line telemetry: each WAN card now shows what the line is actually doing right now, continuously. - Restores the verified Omada session login, so the controller connection is authenticated the proven way again. - Clarifies roaming and device trust: a phone moving between access points is no longer mistaken for a new device. - Closes all outstanding dependency security advisories; the release now passes its own security audit gate. - Signed with Jason's Developer ID and accepted and stapled by Apple's notarization service.
